text_block_list.name: Three-Day Wonder Girl
text_block_list.text: "Great work today~! We're all rooting for your training!"

text_block_list.name: Gym-Bro Middle-Aged Guy
text_block_list.text: "Give it everything you've got for our sake, too!"

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text: "We're counting on you, Bridge!"

After receiving warm send-offs from the community members cheering on Loves Only You,
I shut down my PC.
choice_data_list: What a heartwarming group of people...

text_block_list.text:
Ever since becoming Loves Only You's trainer, my busy schedule
has kept me from posting as much in the community, but...

Even just dropping by to say hello was always met with a warm welcome,
and they never failed to send supportive, watchful encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun! There's something I'd like to consult you about.
Could I have a moment before training begins?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-chan! There's something I'd like to consult you about.
Could I have a moment before training begins?

Interactions like this have become second nature to us now.
—Ever since that day, our trust in each other has grown step by step.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
I stand corrected. An Umamusume who draws strength from running for others truly does exist.
...And you've embodied that perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe ♡
Except I didn't do it alone—it was all of *us* who made it happen ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Having the love of so many people pushing me forward...
As long as I'm not alone, there's no limit to how strong I can become! ♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's go with that plan!
Fufu. I knew it—whenever I'm stuck on something, talking to you is always best.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, let's go with that plan!
Fufu. I knew it—whenever I'm stuck on something, talking to you is always best.

—Having the love of so many people pushing me forward.
Her words echo in my mind.

Things are going great with Loves Only You. Whenever she's troubled,
she comes straight to me, and we've built a solid bond of mutual trust.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, let's get training started!
Let's give it our all today, too!

For all the people supporting her, and for Loves Only You herself.
As her trainer, I need to push myself even further—

I rewatch Loves Only You's past livestreams.
Her love, her fans' love, and the moments connecting them all.

Watching it makes me realize once again that just doing my job as a trainer
isn't going to cut it. I have to support her with something special beyond that...

The next day.
As I sit in the trainer's office, groaning without finding any answers—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A tiny wrinkle between your brows, and such cute groaning noises...
Whatever could Trainer-kun be agonizing over?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
A tiny wrinkle between your brows, and such cute groaning noises...
Whatever could Trainer-chan be agonizing over?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I know your role is to guide Umamusume, but still...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: I know your role is to guide Umamusume, but still...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean you can't come to your trainee...
to me, whenever you're the one needing advice, you know?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Really? Well, if you say so.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
See you later, then!
Love me ♡ Love you ♡ This was Loves Only You! ♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
—Phew! That was so much fun!
Everyone seemed so lively, happy, and just bursting with love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Although.
Bridge-san wasn't... anywhere to be seen today.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(I wonder if something's really bothering them after all.
Are they sitting all alone thinking about it right now...?)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Even if I ask, they probably won't just come out and tell me.
They have such a strong sense of responsibility and work so hard...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(...Could it be about me, maybe?
If so, that makes it even harder for them to say.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
(Even before becoming my trainer, Bridge-san was always
thinking of me, putting their heads together with the rest of my fans.)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...There is always someone keeping me in their thoughts.
Loves Only You, you really are the luckiest girl in the world.
